info.title: toshal-template
info.description: The toshal-template tool: turns .ctt templates (one file, or every file of a folder and its sub folders) into C# classes written next to them, for projects that run it by hand instead of on every build with the Toshal.Template.Generator package.

options.name: --root-namespace
options.description: Root namespace. Default: RootNamespace of the nearest .csproj, else its name.

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: The folders below it become part of the namespace. Default: the folder of the nearest .csproj.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace of the class, instead of root namespace + folders.

options.name: --class
options.description: Class name, instead of the file name (only with one template).

options.name: --writer
options.description:
<%=name%> calls WriteToken(args, output) instead of TokenValue(args).
Also used when Name.cs already has a WriteToken method.
